headline: ACC Limited: Copy of Newspaper Publication
sum: Copy of Newspaper Publication - ACC Limited has informed the exchange about newspaper publication regarding hearing of the joint company petition in the matter of Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited ("Amalgamating Company") with Ambuja…
detail: Copy of Newspaper Publication - ACC Limited has informed the exchange about newspaper publication regarding hearing of the joint company petition in the matter of Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited ("Amalgamating Company") with Ambuja Cements Limited ("Amalgamated Company" or "Company") ("Scheme") before Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench ("Hon''ble Tribunal").
